topic: iOS 27 battery drain, the long version: what the phone is actually doing after an update, how long it lasts, and what helps
details: PILOT for the longform format (landscape 1920x1080, voice-led, screen-carried). Reuses the verified ledger from jobs/ios27-battery-drain plus NEW iOS 27 simulator captures. subject: iOS 27 battery drain, the long version: what the phone is actually doing after an update, how long it lasts, and what helps
audience: iPhone owners a few days into iOS 27, watching the battery fall and deciding whether to panic. They will sit through nine minutes on YouTube that they would never sit through on Reels.
core_value: The one screen that separates 'the update is still working' from 'something is wrong', plus what the phone is doing and which popular fix is worthless.
desired_action: Check Settings > Battery before doing anything drastic; report back in the comments.
tone: Calm, specific, reporting. Chapters, not a list. The reassurance is earned with Apple's own words, never asserted.
footage_constraints: Landscape 1920x1080. Voice-led, screen-carried: iOS 27 SIMULATOR captures (authentic Apple UI, never narrated as 'my phone'), Apple support pages captured on mobile, our own graphics. Presenter at the open and close only.
